What's needed?"},{"id":"M1:T18","text":"If the network receives the 3-digit sequence star star star, sent via DTMF signals, it has to terminate the ongoing VGCS or VBS call."},{"id":"M1:T19","text":"And muting and unmuting for VGCS calls?"},{"id":"M1:T20","text":"So if the network receives the 3-digit sequence hash hash hash via DTMF, or the group call SETUP message, from a controller terminal, it has to send the SET-PARAMETER message with the attribute D-ATT = T, per EN 301 515, Index 6, to the mobile station of the subscriber who's talking.
